messages:
From: Alice Bennett <alice.bennett@finserv.com>

Cc: security@finserv.com
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: VM cadence + SLA statement and CVE attestation for SOC2/SIG intake

Hi Neha,

We're starting our SIG/SOC2 intake for Redwood and need a concise package showing vulnerability management cadence and remediation commitments. Specifically: 1) typical scan cadence (SCA/image and network), 2) SLA windows for CVE remediation by severity tiers, and 3) a signed attestation we can include in the SIG response that commits Redwood to the SLA windows and escalation path.

Can you provide a short attestation PDF and any supporting scan index (last 90 days) and sample remediation tickets? Ideally delivered by EOD Wednesday so our audit team can include it in the packet.

Thanks,
Alice
Alice Bennett
Security Manager, FinServe Capital
attachments: none
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Alice Bennett <alice.bennett@finserv.com>
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: VM cadence + SLA statement and CVE attestation for SOC2/SIG intake

Hi Alice — thanks for the heads-up. We're putting together a compact package:

- vm-scan-index-2027Q1.csv (SCA and image scan timestamps and scope for last 90 days)
- sca-scan-summary-20270315.zip (sample scan export + triage notes)
- cve-remediation-attestation-20270324.pdf (signed SLA/attestation)

Quick answers up front:
- Scan cadence: container/image SCA: nightly full scan for base images + weekly app-layer snapshot; infra/network authenticated scans: weekly; external attack surface scans: bi-weekly.
- SLA by severity: Critical: 48 hours to patch/mitigate + 24 hours hotfix window; High: 7 days; Medium: 30 days; Low: per-release backlog.
- Escalation path: on Critical severity we notify the customer's security contact within 2 hours and engage engineering on-call and account execs as needed.

We're aiming to have the signed PDF and the index to you by EOD Wednesday (2027-03-24). Looping in Kimberly and Karthik for final wording and the signed attestation.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Sr. Security Ops Manager, Redwood Inference
attachments: none
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: kimberly.park@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2027 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: VM cadence + SLA statement and CVE attestation for SOC2/SIG intake

Kimberly / Karthik — draft below for the attestation PDF header/body. Monica, FYI for evidence links. Please suggest edits. We need a short paragraph that is legal-safe but audit friendly.

DRAFT ATTESTATION (proposed):
Redwood Inference hereby attests that for customer workloads in our hosted and dedicated environments we maintain the following vulnerability management program: periodic automated scanning, prioritized remediation by severity tier, and documented escalation. For vulnerabilities rated Critical (CVSS >= 9.0), Redwood will apply mitigations or patches within 48 hours and provide interim compensating controls when immediate patching is not possible. For the purposes of SIG/SOC2 intake, Redwood confirms the stated cadence and SLA windows reflect our current operational practice as of the date of this attestation.

Notes: 1) We should avoid absolute language about "will patch" if there are valid exception processes — propose "apply mitigations or patches" as above. 2) Need signatory: VP Security or Head of Ops — Kimberly, can you sign?

--Neha
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: neha.kapoor@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2027 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: VM cadence + SLA statement and CVE attestation for SOC2/SIG intake

Thanks — wording looks good. Two small edits for clarity:
1) Change "Critical (CVSS >= 9.0)" to "Critical (CVSS >= 9.0 or exploit observed in the wild)" to capture urgent 0-days.
2) Add a final sentence: "Exceptions to the stated SLA are governed by documented risk-acceptance processes and will be communicated to the customer when applicable."

I can sign the PDF as VP, Security & Compliance. Karthik, please attach the csv index and a sanitized remediation ticket example for their review. Monica, can you drop the Drive link to the evidence folder once we assemble?

-Kimberly
